images.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Recipe: establish. A single full-bleed landscape location reference, exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels, PNG. Camera 10 m above the plant's access road on a maintenance platform, looking obliquely down at about 25 degrees, horizon in upper fifth, natural rectilinear wide lens, consistent perspective. Named key light: ordinary cool late-morning daylight from upper left; pale sky visible. Location: the closed, disused water-treatment plant in the hills outside Seoul, exterior to the aqueduct gate. Several large round open-topped concrete settling tanks, 16 m diameter and 4 m deep, stained dry concrete, thin rusty radial scraper arms fixed on hubs, a low flat-roof control building, connecting pipes on supports and perimeter chainlink fencing, overgrown grass on the service lanes. The nearest central tank is completely EMPTY and DRY, its exposed stained concrete floor clearly readable. A properly attached fixed steel access ladder descends its near-left interior wall. The story's only supernatural feature: ONE human-door-height vertical black-violet slit (#1A1026) opening in the inner far concrete wall at floor level INSIDE this empty tank, 2.2 m tall and 0.8 m wide, with a very thin pale white-cyan edge (#D8F4FF). The slit remains small compared with the tank; floor touches its bottom. No portal ring or arch. A narrow pale reflection immediately under the slit only, no broad magical illumination in daylight. The tank rim has a 1.1 m safety rail and the ladder passes through a clear gap in this railing. At least two additional round settling tanks visible behind and to the side; mundane service pipes connect logically. Weathered blank board at closed perimeter entrance, no writing anywhere. No people, vehicles, creatures, ruins from inside the gate, action or UI. This is a quiet industrial exterior with enough scale and clear geometry to serve later continuity. Main tank lower centre, plant buildings upper left, distant green hills upper right, calm pale sky. Keep inked edges and large hard cool shadow shapes, full background detail appropriate to an establishing location key, stone/concrete fully matte with selective hand-drawn weathering. Reference image is ONLY the approved house ink/cel rendering standard and industrial material treatment. Do not copy its night lighting, construction pit, vans or layout.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
review: Closed disused plant; multiple round settling tanks
Dry nearest tank; slit at far inner wall at floor level
Gate reads door height against ladder and four-metre wall
No people or text; daylight, crisp ink and clean cel shadows
Inspected full image, 200-pixel thumbnail and 200-percent detail crop; previews stayed in memory

At least three broad arch openings are fully readable below the deck, not obscured by a foreground wall. A thin dark river at the gorge bottom establishes the depth. Barren steep rocky cliffs to either side, pale yellow sky behind their broken profiles. One entrance on the near left bank and one exit on the far right bank, with NO branching routes, side bridges, stairs or magical gate slit inside the aqueduct scene.
